domestic_evidence: No public GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or contract record could be retrieved: tofler.in returned HTTP 404, thecompanycheck.com and zaubacorp.com returned HTTP 403, and web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused) for all queries. Company website (harsoria.com) states "producing CE-marked devices primarily for export" and "50 Countries to Export" — this is a self-declaration, not shipment evidence, and it points to export orientation rather than documented domestic supply. No domestic supply record found or refuted; field left null rather than invented.
note: Export activity is factually confirmed by dated Indian customs records (latest 2026-02-28) with bill-of-lading numbers (1119324, 1129701, 1127605), destinations USA, France, Yemen, and HS 90183930 — this matches the declared 901839 line. The declared HS codes 293399, 294200 and 701090 were not observed in any visible shipment row; per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground, the factual code is 90183930 (medical disposable devices / IV cannula) and the verdict is accepted_hs_corrected. Role: manufacturer (ISO 13485, own units in Gurgaon, Haryana and Baddi, Himachal Pradesh) — not a trader. Revenue and export volume figures: null, not public in the sources reachable within the call budget. Domestic supply: no traces found either way — stated as unknown, not as 'conditionally accepted'. PAN AABCH1354C was used only as a lookup key and could not be verified against a registry (all registry pages blocked).
